b2-perucosta-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why It Hardly Rains
b2-perucosta-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Peru's coast, and he asks why it almost never rains there.
b2-perucosta-01.prompt: Tell Carlos why it hardly rains on the coast, giving the cause formally.
cues: Give the cause with a formal connector
b2-perucosta-01.target: Debido a la corriente fría, casi no llueve en la costa.
b2-perucosta-01.english: Because of the cold current, it hardly rains on the coast.
b2-perucosta-01.canDo: I can explain a cause formally with *debido a* and *a raíz de* + noun.

b2-perucosta-02.title: Communicative Challenge: When Lima Was Founded
b2-perucosta-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading about colonial Lima, and she asks when the city was founded.
b2-perucosta-02.prompt: Tell Meg when Lima was founded, using the passive.
b2-perucosta-02.target: Lima fue fundada el 18 de enero de 1535.
b2-perucosta-02.canDo: I can say what was founded, listed or proclaimed with the passive (*fue fundada*, *fueron incluidos*).

b2-perucosta-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Even If the Origin Is Unknown
b2-perucosta-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading about the cajón for a short talk, and he asks whether anyone knows how it was born.
b2-perucosta-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that even if its exact origin is not known, the cajón is part of Peruvian music.
cues: Grant the point about the origin
Say what the cajón is part of
b2-perucosta-03.target: Aun cuando no se sepa su origen exacto, el cajón es parte de la música peruana.
b2-perucosta-03.english: Even if its exact origin is not known, the cajón is part of Peruvian music.
b2-perucosta-03.canDo: I can grant a point with *aun cuando* + indicative or subjunctive.

b2-perucosta-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How Cebiche Is Served
b2-perucosta-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning to try Peruvian food, and she asks how cebiche is served.
b2-perucosta-04.prompt: Tell Meg how cebiche is served, using the passive with se.
b2-perucosta-04.canDo: I can choose between passive and impersonal *se* (*se sirven los cebiches*, *se invitó a los vecinos*).

b2-perucosta-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Report I Should Have Read
b2-perucosta-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a talk about the rubber boom, and he asks if you read Casement's report.
b2-perucosta-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that you regret not having read Casement's report earlier.
b2-perucosta-05.target: Me arrepiento de no haber leído antes el informe de Casement.
b2-perucosta-05.english: I regret not having read Casement's report earlier.
b2-perucosta-05.canDo: I can express regrets and reproaches with *debería haber* and *me arrepiento de haber* + participle.

b2-perucosta-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Peru in Review
b2-perucosta-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about Peru, and she asks how to explain that the coast has fewer fish in some years.
b2-perucosta-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that because of El Niño there is less anchoveta, giving the cause formally.
cues: Give the cause with a formal connector
Say that there is less anchoveta
b2-perucosta-consolidation.target: Debido a El Niño, hay menos anchoveta en la costa.
b2-perucosta-consolidation.english: Because of El Niño, there is less anchoveta on the coast.
b2-perucosta-consolidation.canDo: I can explain a cause formally with *debido a* and *a raíz de* + noun.
